name: Secret Cream #5 Buds 4g
description: Secret Cream is the result of an off-site pheno hunt that involved a large amount of seeds. A female “Secret Cheese” from a Fresh Coast Seed Co. seed pack was pollinated by an unknown male. Since the whole room was pollinated, we finished the room out to have large mature seeds. That’s how Secret Cream was born. The mother plant is Secret Cheese and her lineage is: Wifi Og X Cheese. These genetics are infused with a lot of old school strains like Skunk and O.G Kush. She has survived through a rigorous pheno-hunt and some of her lineage will forever be shrouded in mystery
